title.zh: v2.0.45 播放音频绝对同步与卡顿根除、桌面端虚拟键盘100%全宽人机工学展开、移动端防选中与界面精简重构、全界面49项图标与功能深度图解词典
title.en: v2.0.45 Audio-Visual Playhead Synchronization & Lag Elimination, Desktop 100% Full-Width Ergonomic Virtual Keyboard, Mobile Touch Protection & Streamlined Toolbar, and 49-Item Comprehensive Visual Dictionary

highlights.zh: **播放走带绝对同步与卡顿源根除（Playback Synchronization & Zero-Lag Refactor）**：彻底排查并根除了播放循环中的卡顿根源：移除了 `useAudioEngineLifecycle` 中在每一拍/步高频调用系统马达震动（`navigator.vibrate`）导致的 IPC 阻塞，消除了每一拍强行读取 `getBoundingClientRect()` 与 `querySelector` 导致的强制同步重排（Layout Thrashing）；将音频引擎 `visualLeadSec` 预前量精准归零，实现扫描光束与 Web Audio 声学输出的绝对零延迟同步。
highlights.en: **Playback Synchronization & Zero-Lag Refactor**: Fully eliminated the root causes of playback stutter: removed thread-blocking high-frequency `navigator.vibrate` calls from `onStep`, cached step positions to completely eradicate synchronous layout thrashing (`getBoundingClientRect` / DOM queries), and zeroed out `visualLeadSec` (25ms -> 0ms) for sample-accurate acoustic audio-visual playhead synchronization.

highlights.zh: **桌面端虚拟键盘 100% 全宽自适应与人机工学琴键（Desktop 100% Full-Width Ergonomic Keybed）**：彻底解除 1200px 宽度钳制与两侧空隙，窗口固定吸附于屏幕底端并水平 100% 铺满；琴键垂直高度精简至贴合 DAW 标准的轻量高度（`h-28 ~ h-36`），白键扩充为 2 个完整八度（15 个白键 + 10 个黑键），琴键比例舒展自然，配合 QWERTY 键盘映射、Z/X 八度升降与 Tab 延音，打造开箱即用的专业弹奏体验。
highlights.en: **Desktop 100% Full-Width Ergonomic Keybed**: Removed the 1200px max-width clamp to achieve true 100% full-width docked keybed expansion. Streamlined keybed height to an ergonomic DAW scale (`h-28 ~ h-36`) while expanding the key count to 2 full octaves (15 white keys + 10 black keys), delivering authentic piano proportions, Z/X octave controls, and Tab sustain.

highlights.zh: **移动端长按/拖拽全域防选中与触控锁（Mobile Anti-Selection & Touch Protection）**：在全局 CSS 与核心工作区层级全面注入 `-webkit-touch-callout: none`、`-webkit-user-select: none`、`user-select: none` 与 `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent`，彻底杜绝在移动设备上快速点音、长按或滑动画布时意外呼出系统选择框、蓝色文本遮罩或弹出菜单，同时严格保留输入框（input/textarea）的原生文本编辑能力。
highlights.en: **Mobile Anti-Selection & Touch Protection**: Injected `-webkit-touch-callout: none`, `-webkit-user-select: none`, `user-select: none`, and `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` across global stylesheets and sequencer grids, completely preventing accidental blue selection overlays and system callout popups during rapid tapping or dragging, while safely preserving native input editing.
